subject: Game Theory
title: Commitment Devices
description: A short lesson to help you apply Commitment Devices.

hook.text: Cortés burned his ships in Mexico. His soldiers couldn't retreat. The only option was to fight and win.

buildup.text: A commitment device makes defection impossible or very costly. It's voluntary self-binding to build credibility.

discovery.text: Thomas Schelling showed that limiting your own options can be strategically powerful. Weakness becomes strength.

twist.text: Wedding rings, deposit forfeits, and public promises all work the same way: raising the cost of backing out.

climax.text: NATO's nuclear strategy used commitment: station troops as 'tripwires' so any attack guarantees escalation.

punchline.text: Burn the ships to prove you'll stay.

quiz.question: What is a commitment device?
options: A way to make promise-breaking costly
